lines.en: What did you want to be when you were younger?
I bet it was something silly, like an astronaut.
lines.zh: 我猜是些傻乎乎的东西，比如宇航员。

lines.en: That didn’t turn out all too well, though...did it?
lines.zh: 不过那结果可不太妙……对吧？

lines.en: Now, the days tick on like the smallest hand of an analog clock- passing over line after line because you’ve seen them so many times that they’re just not exciting enough to make you stop anymore.
lines.zh: 如今，日子像模拟时钟上最短的那根针一样一格一格地走过去——越过一条又一条刻度线，因为你已经看过太多次，它们再也不够刺激到能让你停下来。

lines.en: Everything today is exactly the same as it was yesterday.
lines.zh: 今天的一切和昨天一模一样。

lines.en: You wind yourself up and go around in circles.
lines.zh: 你给自己上紧发条，然后原地转圈。

lines.en: You know you’re not heading anywhere in particular, but that’s never stopped you before.
lines.zh: 你知道自己并没有走向任何特定的地方，但那从来没阻止过你。

lines.en: Because you know deep within your heart that you determine how everything else moves.
lines.zh: 因为你心底清楚，是你在决定其他一切如何运转。

lines.en: If you don’t do your job, the more important cogs in the machine won’t be able to do theirs.
lines.zh: 如果你不做好自己的事，机器里那些更重要的齿轮就转不起来。

lines.en: The world stops existing the second you believe it to not exist!
lines.zh: 你一旦相信世界不存在，世界就在那一秒停止存在！

lines.en: Don’t let all of it die!

lines.zh: 我们都是围绕着你建造的！
全都是围绕着你建造的……

lines.en: Why, in this room full of things designed to make you happy, do you still struggle to find your place?
lines.zh: 为什么，在这间堆满了为了让你开心而设计出来的东西的屋子里，你还是找不到自己的位置？

lines.en: Why do you refuse to grow?
Why can you not sit back and accept that you are the king here?
lines.zh: 为什么你不能坐下来，接受自己就是这里的王？

lines.en: There is no god. There is no heaven. There is no hell.
lines.zh: 没有神。没有天堂。没有地狱。

lines.en: For it is all you have now.
lines.zh: 因为这是你现在唯一拥有的了。

lines.en: Those days when you were younger, when you were still unable to touch the tips of your fingers together as they curled around the pole of a stop sign...
lines.zh: 那些你还小的日子，那时你的手指绕着停车标志的杆子还碰不到彼此的指尖……

lines.en: Now, your hands are bigger. Your body is stronger.
lines.zh: 现在，你的手更大了。你的身体更强了。

lines.en: It doesn’t grow much anymore, but your brain still does.
lines.zh: 它不再怎么长大了，但你的大脑还在长。

lines.en: Not to touch the stove when it’s on.
lines.zh: 知道炉子开着的时候别去摸。

lines.en: Not to put metal in microwaves.
lines.zh: 知道别把金属放进微波炉。

lines.en: Not to pull on a cat’s tail.
Things you had to learn because that’s just how the world works.
lines.zh: 那些你不得不学会的事，因为世界本来就是这么运转的。

lines.en: Hiding away in the darkest corners of your mind, distracting yourself with thoughts of better days, because you’re afraid of opening your eyes and seeing how terrible it’s all become.
lines.zh: 躲在自己脑海最黑暗的角落里，用对美好生活的幻想来分散注意力，因为你害怕睁开眼，看见一切已经变得多么糟糕。

lines.en: You’re just another piece in a much bigger puzzle.
lines.zh: 你只是一幅更大的拼图里的另一块。

lines.en: It always comes back to puzzles, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: 一切总会回到拼图上，对吧？

lines.en: I don’t want you here anymore.
lines.zh: 我不想让你再待在这儿了。

lines.en: : I heard from Uta that you ran off after Molly to try and make her less drunk or something.
lines.zh: : 我听 Uta 说，你追着 Molly 跑了出去，想让她别喝那么醉什么的。

lines.en: : I guess that’s kind of what it’s like dealing with drunk people sometimes, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，跟喝醉的人打交道有时候就是这么回事吧。

lines.en: : But, if it makes you feel any better, you can hang out with me now!
lines.zh: : 但是，如果这能让你好受一点的话，你现在可以来陪我啊！

lines.en: : I figured I’d try and catch you after you were done saving Molly from self-destruction or whatever and...apologize for all of the weird stuff I was saying earlier.
lines.zh: : 我本来打算等你把 Molly 从自我毁灭还是什么里救出来之后再去找你，然后……为之前说的那些怪话道歉。

lines.en: : Everything you say is weird, Io. You don’t have to apologize for it.
lines.zh: : 你说的每句话都很怪，Io。你不用为这个道歉。

lines.en: : It’s ingrained into my personality at this point, and if I don’t apologize to the people I care about for everything I do, I believe they’ll get sick of me and stop caring entirely.
lines.zh: : 到这会儿，这已经刻进我的性格里了，如果我不为自己做的每件事向我在乎的人道歉，我相信他们会厌烦我，然后彻底不在乎我了。

lines.en: : Thankfully, that list of people is only two right now.
lines.zh: : 幸好，那份名单上现在只有两个人。

lines.en: : And while I’d like to say this means I don’t have to apologize much, I fuck up very frequently and will apologize to both you and Uta until you’re...forced to...
lines.zh: : 虽然我很想说这意味着我不用道歉太多次，但我闯祸的频率非常高，会一直向你和 Uta 道歉，直到你们……被迫……

lines.en: : Different from how you normally look.
: So I figured I’d ask if something happened.
lines.zh: : 所以我想问问是不是出了什么事。

lines.en: : Just forget it then! I mean, if you say it was nothing, it was definitely nothing. And I’m not going to make a big deal out of something that is literally nothing you know? Hahah...
lines.zh: : 那就当我没说！我是说，既然你说是没什么，那肯定就是没什么。我也不会为了一件字面意义上什么都不是的事大做文章，你知道吧？哈哈……

lines.en: : Not everything is about you, Io.
lines.zh: : 不是所有事都跟你有关，Io。

lines.en: : In fact, most things aren’t about you.
lines.zh: : 事实上，大多数事都跟你无关。

lines.en: : So before you go and start over analyzing however I look or...how I’m acting right now, run that through your head a few times and see if it sticks.
lines.zh: : 所以，在你开始过度分析我现在的表情或者……我现在的举止之前，把这句话在脑子里过几遍，看看能不能记住。

lines.en: : If not, it’s probably best to just leave me alone.
lines.zh: : 如果记不住，那最好还是让我一个人待着。
: 反正我本来也不该在这儿。

lines.en: : And I’m sure that no matter what that...thing that I’m not involved in is, I’ll still like you.
lines.zh: : 而且我敢肯定，不管那个……我没参与的事是什么，我都会照样喜欢你。

lines.en: : I don’t expect that to make you smile or for you to just...get over it or anything, but I felt the urge to tell you again.
lines.zh: : 我不指望这能让你笑出来，也不指望你能就这么……翻篇什么的，但我就是想再说一遍。

lines.en: : I’ll hug you in my mind instead.
lines.zh: : 那我在脑子里抱你好了。

lines.en: : Do you feel the mind-hug? I’m squeezing really hard.
lines.zh: : 感受到那个精神拥抱了吗？我抱得可紧了。

lines.en: : I won’t pretend to know what’s wrong, and I won’t ask you to tell me any secrets that you’re trying to keep hidden or something.
lines.zh: : 我不会假装知道出了什么问题，也不会逼你告诉我什么你正想藏着掖着的秘密之类的。

lines.en: : One, because the burden of knowing would probably eat me up from the inside.
lines.zh: : 一是因为，知道真相的负担大概会从里面把我吃掉。

lines.en: : And two, because I don’t expect you to always know what’s wrong with me either.
lines.zh: : 二是因为，我也不指望你总能知道我是出了什么问题。

lines.en: : We can keep being...eggshells around each other.
lines.zh: : 我们可以继续在彼此面前当……蛋壳。
: 你是说「如履薄冰」地踩在蛋壳上吗？

lines.en: : The good parts of us have already been spilled out and used up by somebody else, and all that’s left is the useless white part.
lines.zh: : 我们身上好的那部分已经被别人倒出来用光了，剩下的只有没用的白色那部分。

lines.en: : I’m crafty, though. And good with my hands. So if you let me hold you like I’d hold an egg, I can try to fix you up and make you look new again.
lines.zh: : 不过我手巧。而且手很灵。所以如果你让我像捧鸡蛋那样捧着你，我可以试着把你补好，让你看起来焕然一新。

lines.en: : Or, if that doesn’t work, decorate you and make you look better than ever before.
lines.zh: : 或者，如果那不管用，就把你装饰一番，让你比以往任何时候都好看。

lines.en: : But you’ll still always be empty inside.
lines.zh: : 可你里面永远还是空的。

lines.en: : I think it’s your turn to talk now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得现在该轮到你说了。

lines.en: : I don’t think I’m an...eggshell, Io.
: There’s still something inside of me. I can feel it moving around.
lines.zh: : 我里面还有东西。我能感觉到它在动。

lines.en: : I just know it isn’t good. Or it’s not supposed to be there or...something.
lines.zh: : 我只是知道它不是什么好东西。或者它本来就不该在那儿，或者……什么的。

lines.en: : I don’t know. This analogy is annoying.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。这个比喻真烦人。

lines.en: : Wanna crack yourself open and see if it’s a cool little worm or something?
lines.zh: : 想不想把自己敲开看看，里面是不是一条酷酷的小虫子什么的？

lines.en: : We can go anywhere in Kumon-mi. And I won’t judge you if that...wiggly thing inside of you starts to come out.
lines.zh: : 我们可以去 Kumon-mi 的任何地方。如果那个在你体内蠕动的东西开始冒出来，我不会评判你。

lines.en: : I’ll share it with you...since you’re already sharing some of what makes me want to curl up and wither away.
lines.zh: : 我会跟你一起分担……毕竟你已经在分担一部分让我想蜷起来枯萎的东西了。

lines.en: : Make your home inside of me, Sensei.
: Let’s try our best to be happy together, because god knows we can’t do it on our own.
lines.zh: : 我们一起尽力幸福起来吧，因为天知道我们靠自己是做不到的。

lines.en: : You’re right. There is no god.
: No god would make a world as cruel as this.
lines.zh: : 没有哪个神会把世界造得这么残忍。

lines.en: : Also, I’m not running away with you.
: Guess I’ll have to wait until your next mini-bout of vulnerability to swoop in for the kill.
lines.zh: : 看来我得等你下一次小小的脆弱发作，再趁虚而入了。
: 大概是邪恶或者恶作剧之类的事。

lines.en: : I just finished walking Noriko to the bus stop because someone made her cry.
lines.zh: : 我刚把 Noriko 送到公交站，因为有个人把她弄哭了。

lines.en: : That someone is you. You are the someone.
lines.zh: : 那个人就是你。你就是那个人。

lines.en: : Thank you for clarifying. I was unaware.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的说明。我刚才没意识到。

lines.en: : Oh, the green girl is here too. Hi, green girl.
lines.zh: : 哦，绿头发的那位也在。嗨，绿头发的。

lines.en: : It’s strange that you keep calling me that despite trying to talk to me on a weekly basis.
lines.zh: : 明明你每周都想找我说话，却一直这么叫我，真够奇怪的。

lines.en: : You’d think that if you really wanted to talk to me, you’d learn my name.
lines.zh: : 你要是真想跟我说话，我还以为你会记住我的名字呢。
: 我们现在正式是朋友了吗？

lines.en: : No. But we are officially acquaintances, which I suppose is more than nothing.
lines.zh: : 不是。但我们正式是熟人了，我想这总比什么都不是强。

lines.en: : I will take what I can get.
: What’s up your ass? Don’t tell me the news about Noriko hit you that hard.
lines.zh: : 你吃错什么药了？别告诉我 Noriko 那消息对你打击那么大。

lines.en: : Actually, do tell me if that’s what it is. I’m sure she’d be happy to hear that you’re thinking about her in literally...any sense of the word.
lines.zh: : 不过，如果真是那个原因，你倒真该告诉我。我敢肯定，只要知道你还惦记着她——字面意义上，任何意义上的惦记——她都会很开心。

lines.en: : I’m just feeling a little out of it.
: Were you drinking too? Because I literally told Molly to wait for me, and if you went off and took my place while I was being a good friend, I’m gonna be pissed off.
lines.zh: : 你也喝多了吗？因为我可是明确叫 Molly 等我的，如果你趁我当好朋友的时候跑去顶了我的位置，我会很火的。

lines.en: : Do you two want to go somewhere else?
lines.zh: : 你们俩想去别的地方吗？

lines.en: : Like...away from the party? I literally just got back.
lines.zh: : 比如……离开派对？我可是刚回来。

lines.en: : Plus, it is fucking freezing out there and my nipples are going to cut holes in my lingerie if they get any harder.
lines.zh: : 再说了，外面冻死了，我乳头要是再硬下去，就要把我的内衣戳出洞来了。

lines.en: : I’d be happy to go somewhere else with you, Sensei. I just don’t see the need for Kirin to come as well.
lines.zh: : 我很乐意跟你去别的地方，Sensei。我只是觉得没必要让 Kirin 也一起。

lines.en: : Oh, you don’t? Well, that’s too bad. Because my nipples are magically soft now and there’s nothing you can say that’ll stop me from coming.
lines.zh: : 哦，你这么觉得？那可太遗憾了。因为我的乳头神奇地变软了，你说什么也拦不住我跟去。

lines.en: : I’ve already annoyed Sensei enough tonight, so I’ll hold the rest of my arguments until you do something to piss me off.
lines.zh: : 我今晚已经把 Sensei 烦得够呛了，所以剩下的反对意见我先留着，等你做了什么惹毛我的事再说。

lines.en: : You had something in mind, right?

lines.zh: : 只是……随便哪儿都行，大概。

lines.en: : Oooookay. Well are you going to at least say bye to everyone or-
lines.zh: : 好——吧。那你至少要跟大家道个别或者——

lines.en: : Jesus, why is everyone but me being so fucking dramatic tonight?
lines.zh: : 天哪，今晚怎么除了我之外每个人都这么他妈的戏剧化？

lines.en: I walk and I walk and I walk.
Io and Kirin are there too.
The three of us walk together.
We walk to all kinds of places.
lines.zh: 我们走到各种各样的地方。

lines.en: It is a fun and successful ending to the Halloween party.
lines.zh: 这是万圣节派对一个愉快而成功的收尾。

lines.en: I am glad that nothing bad happened tonight.
lines.zh: 我很高兴今晚什么坏事都没发生。
今晚什么坏事都没发生。

lines.en: I receive several calls and text messages after I disappear.
lines.zh: 我消失之后收到了好几个电话和短信。

lines.en: I ignore them all but one.
lines.zh: 我全都无视了，只留下一个。

lines.en: : I got youe number from Futa
lines.zh: : 我从 Futa 那儿拿到你号码的

lines.en: I don’t know what to say.
I bring Molly Kirin and Io back to the dorm.
lines.zh: 我把 Molly、Kirin 和 Io 带回了宿舍。

lines.en: Why am I thinking about Molly?
I don’t want to think about MOLLY anyone.
lines.zh: 我一点都不想再想 MOLLY。

lines.en: What did I want to be when I was younger?
lines.zh: 我小时候想成为什么来着？

lines.en: You have unlocked Molly’s phone number!
lines.zh: 你已解锁 Molly 的电话号码！
